  the scheduler's record since the health reset (stage 2): the slot is fixed by CT16B4,
  latency is the handler's entry from the slot boundary, elapsed its entry to exit;
  missed slots are boundaries the handler did not service, omitted pulses the slots it
  serviced too late to arm (or across a slot); a dark row is neither.
  elapsed_mean_us is cumulative and its sum wraps after 89 s of handler time (about
  7.6 min of uptime at 52 us a slot): the win_ figures (--window) are the ones to quote
